title: Veritas wins the prestigious NSTC/Natcast Workforce Development Grant of $1.28M
description: Veritas signed a $1.28M contract with Natcast under the auspices of the US Department of Commerce. The funding supports WAVE-CHIP (Workforce Advancement in Verification and Evaluation of Chips), a program designed to tackle the critical shortage of skilled verification engineers in the semiconductor industry by expanding education and workforce development opportunities.

title: Veritas offers Train-the-Trainer Workshop to Faculty from R1/R2 Institutions
description: Veritas organized a train-the-trainer workshop during August 11–15, 2025 at Texas A&M University to facilitate instructor training in hardware verification. The workshop was attended by 15 instructors from neighboring R1/R2 institutions.

title: Veritas publishes 3 papers in prestigious MLCAD Conference
description: Congratulations to recent graduates Minh Luu and Surya Jasper, and continuing PhD student Chengjia Liu for publishing their research at the 7th ACM/IEEE International Symposium on Machine Learning for CAD.
